```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 06_probability_marbles
title: >
  Does the First Draw Change the Second?
questions:
  - id: second_white
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      A jar has 10 white marbles and 40 blue marbles. You draw one white marble and
      do not replace it. What is the probability that the second marble is white?
    answer: >
      The probability is 9/49, or about .18, because one white marble has been
      removed and 49 marbles remain.
    explanation: >
      Without replacement, the second draw depends on the first. In symbols,
      $P(\text{second white} \mid \text{first white}) = 9/49$.

  - id: replacement
    type: true-false
    prompt: >
      If you replace the first marble and mix the jar, drawing white first makes
      blue more likely on the next draw.
    answer: false
    explanation: >
      Replacement restores the same 10 white and 40 blue marbles. The next draw
      is independent of the first: white still has probability .2 and blue .8.
```
